button.label: Zero decimals
button.supertip: Keep currency, accounting, commas and percentages. Dates, times and fractions stay unchanged. Values retain full precision.

button.label: Assumption
button.supertip: Blue text and pale yellow fill for editable model assumptions.

button.label: Header
button.supertip: Dark gray fill, bold white text and thin white borders around each cell.

button.label: Copy exact
button.supertip: Copy one cell or rectangular range into SheetFreak's private buffer. Formula references will remain unchanged on paste.

button.label: Paste exact
button.screentip: Paste without shifting references. Select a top-left destination cell or a matching rectangle. Does not paste formatting.

button.label: Fill and freeze
button.supertip: Select a row of formulas, choose a last-row reference column, and confirm. Calculates all formulas, then freezes lower rows as values. Applies black text and AutoFit. Does not create a backup workbook.

button.label: Auto resize
button.supertip: Return to A1 and fit populated columns at 70-200% zoom. Compact sheets can zoom in; wider sheets zoom out. Column widths and freeze panes stay unchanged.
